OSHA & EN 131

Regulatory Safety Compliance

  • EN 131: European safety certification ensuring dimensional limits, load bearing test passes, and anti-slip stability.
  • OSHA 1910.25: American regulation standardizing rise/run configurations, step angles, and handrail loading capacity.
  • Slip-Resistance: Specialized grooved aluminum tread profiles preventing oil/chemical accumulation.
  • Material Quality: Made exclusively from structural-grade 6061-T6 aluminum alloy.

Designed for Maximum Job Site Safety

Occupational safety is at the core of the ModularStep engineering philosophy. Every component of our modular platform system undergoes strict stress analysis and inspection before shipment.

By utilizing our standardized, pre-engineered aluminum steps, platforms, and handrails, you bypass local engineering review delays and field-welding safety hazards. Simply bolt the components together in a few hours using standard hand tools.
